Gulliver & typography

Gulliver adapts the user-owned, code-drawn Eastbourne gull from the supplied personal dashboard, adding an explorer’s hat, scarf and suitcase. This is a draft character asset, not the College logo. No personal P or C symbols are used.

Nimbus Roman and Nimbus Sans are bundled unmodified from the existing personal homepage. Font copyright, licence and source details.

Content notes

The Pompeii archive screens use a location photograph of the forum. It does not show either discovery, and the caption says so. Career connections are editorial examples of transferable skills, not promises of admission or employment. Gulliver’s remarks are fictional.

When replacing an image, keep the creator, original link, licence and any required adaptation notice with the file. Update this page and assets/credits.json.
